chunks: Yaḥyā ibn ʿAbd Allāh Abū al-Ḥasan, Ṣāḥib al-Daylam, narrated to us; he said:
I heard Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام saying, while there were some people from the people of al-Kūfah in his presence:

How astonishing concerning the people: they took all of their knowledge from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, then acted by it and were guided, yet they think that the people of his Household did not take his knowledge—while we are the people of his Household and his progeny. In our homes the Revelation descended, and from us knowledge went out to them. Do they then think that they came to know and were guided, while we remained ignorant and went astray? Indeed, this is impossible.

key_terms.أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ: his Household, the family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْعِلْمُ: sacred knowledge originating from the Prophet’s Household
key_terms.الْوَحْيُ: divine revelation sent down by Allah
key_terms.اهْتَدَوْا: they were guided to the right path
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, the source of divine teaching

ai.seo_question: Why does Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say that the knowledge of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم is with Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that the knowledge of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم is most rightfully found with Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, in whose homes Revelation descended. It rejects the notion that others could possess and act upon the Prophet’s knowledge while his own Household remained ignorant of it, presenting this as an impossibility.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub who said, ‘Yahya Bin Abdullah Abu Al Hassan Sahib Al Daylam said,
‘I heard Ja’far Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> saying, and in his<sup>asws</sup> presence were people from the inhabitants of Al-Kufa:

‘I<sup>asws</sup> am astounded at the people. They are taking their knowledge, all of it as being from Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and they are acting by it, and are guiding, and they are reporting that the People<sup>asws</sup> of his<sup>saww</sup> Household are not taking his<sup>saww</sup> knowledge, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the People<sup>asws</sup> of his<sup>saww</sup> Household, and his<sup>saww</sup> offspring. In our<sup>asws</sup> Household did the Revelation descend, and from us<sup>asws</sup> did the knowledge come out to them. Are they reporting that they are knowing and are being guided, and we<sup>asws</sup> are ignorant and straying? This is impossible!’
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub who has said that Yahya ibn ‘Abdallah abu al-Hassan the companion of al-Daylam narrated to us and who has said the following.
“Once I heard Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (a.s.) say while a group of people of Kufa was present before him,

“It is very strange of the people. They have received their knowledge from the Messenger of Allah. They have followed such knowledge and found guidance but they think that his Ahl al-Bayt (members of his family) have not received his knowledge. We are his Ahl al-Bayt (members of his family) and his descendants. In our house Divine inspiration came down and from us knowledge came out to them. Do they think that they have learned and found guidance but we remained ignorant and lost. This, certainly, is not possible.”
